title: Web CAD, free 911 voice announcements, and a Premium trial
changes: New: there is a full CAD you can use in a browser at roleplaymanager.xyz/cad. Sign in with Discord, pick your server, and you get the same records the bot already uses. A character made on the site is the one officers find when they run your name
Civilians can register characters, vehicles and firearms, call 911, and pay fines. Officers get a live call queue, records search by plate or name, tickets, BOLOs, 10 codes and a panic button

New: 911 calls are now read out in your patrol voice channel on every server, free. The bot joins when a call comes in, announces it, and leaves again. The AI dispatcher that listens and talks back is still Premium
New: Premium has a 7 day free trial and you no longer need to vote for it. Run /activatetrial to start
New: /cad gives anyone the link to the web CAD
Plates, licence numbers, social security numbers, vehicle VINs and firearm serials are all issued automatically now, so nobody has to invent one
Fixed: you could not create a second character on a server. The plate check was rejecting anyone who had not set a plate, which was most people
Fixed: paying a fine on the website did not take the money out of your bank account
Fixed: the AI dispatcher had stopped replying to everything, because the model it ran on was retired. It now moves to a working one by itself
Fixed: asking dispatch to run a name never worked, only plates. Dispatch also says what somebody is wanted for now, instead of only that they are
Fixed: servers on the Premium trial were getting no AI voice dispatch at all
